objective: Test whether target-aware perception and increased finite resource availability during training improve learned resource behavior without sacrificing original-simulator return.

training.resource_profile_definition: The existing seeded starter world plus finite additional patch positions (8 forage, 5 water total). No replenishment, reward, physiology or action semantics are changed.
training.training_reward: Only variants I/J use the separately implemented need-conditioned exploratory shaping. It is not used for scoring, model acceptance, ranking or return reporting.
training.distributed_strategy: Independent single-process model jobs; no DDP. Select single/dual device schedule only after bounded same-kernel throughput calibration.

perception_v2.distance_semantics: The distance features ignore depleted patches and use shortest obstacle-aware 4-neighbour path length to visible, available resource targets; legacy-v1 remains the default for historical checkpoints.

known_design_limits: The default simulator has finite, one-use forage and one water patch for five agents; no biological resource renewal model is claimed.
Reward contains a state-independent positive REST bonus in the historical control; it is preserved for common evaluation.
Memory is encoded as recent outcome bits and recency, while stored event locations are not features; memory influence remains measured rather than assumed.
Static path-distance perception ignores dynamic animal occupancy; the navigation layer still reports reason-coded dynamic outcomes.
